temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl looks stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project; Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria has no specific prior belief that Cheryl is struggling; she generally sees Cheryl as a colleague involved in community work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Maria learns that Cheryl is currently overwhelmed and is receptive to assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is stressed and needs help with the outreach project, and she welcomes Maria's support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and empathy, with a willingness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning so Cheryl feels less overwhelmed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing more confident; at the staff meeting Cheryl accepts the suggested leadership role and thanks Maria for her confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl was previously overwhelmed but has improved with support and is capable of managing responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Maria's belief strengthens: Cheryl has the aptitude, commitment, and readiness for leadership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, committed, and ready to lead the next phase of the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and help the project succeed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl tells Maria she was a bit surprised by the leadership suggestion but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria worries Cheryl might feel overstepped or pressured by the leadership suggestion, despite Maria's good intentions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Maria learns Cheryl does not feel pressured and values Maria's support and belief.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl appreciates Maria's honesty and support; the relationship remains positive and trusting.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To ensure Cheryl feels supported and not pressured, and to maintain a good working relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl values Maria's honesty and support; when Maria proposes co-leading the project, Cheryl calls it a fantastic idea and says Maria's guidance is invaluable and they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl appreciates her support and that they can continue collaborating well.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Maria learns Cheryl is enthusiastic about co-leading and sees their partnership as valuable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl can effectively co-lead the project and support each other as a team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, their partnership has strengthened; Cheryl says she would love to work together on future projects and is excited about what they can achieve.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their co-leadership and collaboration have been positive and that they make a strong team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Maria's belief is confirmed and expanded: their synergy is fruitful, and Cheryl is eager for future collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl have a strong, successful partnership with promising future collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl on more projects in the future.
